changes: All battlegrounds now activate Highground by default, including Seething Shore. Older accounts and saved profiles are upgraded to include unrated matches.
New installations start quietly with fewer rows and optional setup help. Main settings appear first, with detailed controls under More options or More settings.
Macro presets have clearer target and save choices, optional highlighted code previews, and guidance for adding a saved macro to your action bar.
Bounty forms and empty boards are clearer. Enemy journals and match history add Undo delete, easier search and paging that works with larger text.
notice: Restart the game after updating; standalone settings include an additional file. Keep the bundled HighgroundBountyData folder enabled. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
